Triple match game can be rebranded (e.g., 'Zen Stack Match' or 'Tile Stack Master')

Block Puzzle level engine needs adaptive difficulty for Mission Mode + NEW Endless Mode (game over when board is full)

typography.font_pairings: Outfit Black for headlines and title badges; Manrope Medium/Bold for HUD & instructions; Bebas Neue for combo counters and level numbers

contrast_rules.blocked_tiles: Desaturated, darkened with backdrop tint to clearly differentiate from clickable top tiles
contrast_rules.active_tiles: Full opacity, sharp 2.5D drop shadow, gold/amber border highlight on hover/tap
contrast_rules.hud: High contrast pill backgrounds with 2px solid dark borders

raster_assets_strategy.rule: STRICTLY NO SVGs for tile game pieces. All game tiles, block skins, and collectible graphics MUST use raster images (PNG / WebP / JPG).

unsplash_enhancements.category: Level Card Cover - Block Puzzle Neon

stacked_tile_match_blueprint.game_title: Zen Stack Match / Tile Stack Master
stacked_tile_match_blueprint.core_concept: Mahjong-style multi-layered overlapping tile tableau. Tiles overlap in 3D layers (Layer 0, Layer 1, Layer 2, Layer 3). A tile is only selectable (FREE) if NO tile on a higher layer overlaps its boundary box.

tableau_geometry.container: relative w-full max-w-sm aspect-[4/5] mx-auto bg-amber-50/50 rounded-3xl p-4 border-2 border-slate-800/20 shadow-inner overflow-hidden
tableau_geometry.tile_size: w-14 h-16 (56px x 64px) with rounded-2xl 2.5D card shape
tableau_geometry.coordinate_system: Relative X, Y percentage offsets (0-100%) + Z-index layer depth (0 to 4)
tableau_geometry.overlap_detection: isZenTileFree(state, tile): tile has no higher layer (layer > tile.layer) whose bounding box (x, y, width, height) intersects tile by > 15%

visual_states.free_tile: cursor-pointer scale-100 opacity-100 shadow-[0_6px_0_#0f172a] hover:-translate-y-1 active:translate-y-0.5 bg-white border-2 border-slate-800 z-[layer*10 + 10]
visual_states.blocked_tile: cursor-not-allowed opacity-60 grayscale-[30%] shadow-none bg-slate-200 border-2 border-slate-400 z-[layer*10] pointer-events-none before:absolute before:inset-0 before:bg-black/25 before:rounded-2xl

tray_rack.container_style: grid grid-cols-7 gap-1.5 bg-amber-100/90 border-4 border-amber-400/80 rounded-2xl p-2.5 shadow-[0_8px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.15)]
tray_rack.slot_style: aspect-square rounded-xl border-2 border-amber-300 bg-white/80 shadow-inner flex items-center justify-center relative overflow-hidden
tray_rack.clear_logic: When 3 identical raster tiles enter the tray, trigger instant pop-out particle effect, play match sound, remove 3 tiles, shift remaining tiles left, add score + 300

onet_level_engine_blueprint.shell_tile_mechanic: 2x1 horizontal shell tiles or 1x2 vertical shell tiles starting at level 3. Breaking a 2x1 shell turns it into two distinct 1x1 raster tiles.

adaptive_difficulty_curve.level_6_to_15: 12 tile pairs + 2x1 shell tiles, 90s limit, static stone obstacles
adaptive_difficulty_curve.level_16_to_30: 15 tile pairs + 2x1 & 1x2 shell tiles, 75s limit, shifting rows after clear
adaptive_difficulty_curve.level_31_plus: Max tile variety (15 kinds), 60s limit, ice-frozen tiles needing 2 hits, gravity drops

modes.title: Misi Level (Mission Mode)
modes.description: Selesaikan target skor, kumpulkan tile warna khusus, atau hapus N baris dengan batasan langkah
modes.adaptive_difficulty: Increase board pre-fill grid complexity, spawn 3x3 L-shapes and 5-bar blocks more frequently as level scales

modes.title: Modus Infinity (Endless Mode)
modes.description: Main tanpa batas! Papan terus berjalan sampai tidak ada ruang tersisa untuk 3 balok yang tersedia.
modes.lose_condition: GAMEOVER when none of the 3 current block pieces can fit anywhere on the 8x8 grid.
modes.scoring: Combo multipliers for multi-line clears (Single: 100, Double: 300, Triple: 700, Tetris 4-Line: 1500)

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Strictly use raster images (.png / .webp) for all tiles and game tokens. Never use inline SVG path graphics for game tiles.
Implement true 2.5D overlapping tile stack logic for Zen Match using calculated relative top/left offsets and Z-indexes.
Ensure blocked tiles have a distinct dark semi-transparent overlay and grayscale effect to signal non-interactivity.
Keep standard startup lobby untouched while delivering high visual polish on LevelSelectScreen and ZenMatchScreen.
Maintain high APCA contrast ratios on all game texts, HUD overlays, and modal alerts.
Attach all specified data-testid attributes to allow automated E2E test verification.
